name: torn-revive-chat-collector
description: ReviveRelay public revive-candidate client and isolated direct-request backend for Torn.

scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && node --check dist/review/ReviveRelay-0.6.3.user.js
scripts.verify:review: node scripts/verify-review-artifact.js && npm run test:client:raw && npm run test:server && node --check dist/review/ReviveRelay-0.6.3.user.js && node --test test/review-release-smoke.test.js test/release-dependency-verification.test.js && npm run audit:review && node scripts/verify-review-artifact.js
scripts.release:client: npm run check && node scripts/release-client.js --channel review
